manifesto.headline: BRIDGING CLASSROOM STRATEGY WITH REAL-WORLD CHAOS.
paragraphs: MAC, The Marketing Club of Sri Venkateswara College, stands as an industrial hub for creativity, consumer strategy, and execution. Through live corporate projects, high-stakes business simulations, and primary research, we shape marketers who challenge conventions.
Founded in 2017, we have consistently operated not as an extracurricular club, but as an underground creative agency and research laboratory on campus.
manifesto.mediaCaption: FIG_00 // THE_COLLECTIVE // SRI VENKATESWARA COLLEGE, DU

items.label: [AUTONOMOUS CAMPAIGNS]:
items.text: Zero bureaucratic red tape. Students conceptualize, pitch, and fund all operations from the ground up without commercial compromise.

items.label: [DATA + CRAFT DUALITY]:
items.text: Every artistic execution is backed by quantitative audience analytics and SEO metrics, ensuring aesthetic excellence with empirical conversion.

items.label: [COLLEGIATE TALENT INCUBATOR]:
items.text: Proven pipeline placing alumni into top marketing agencies, fast-growing consumer unicorns, and Tier-1 strategy consulting firms.

items.label: [FLAGSHIP ARENAS]:
items.text: Annual business symposiums hosting 2,500+ participants nationwide under cutthroat crisis-room rulesets.

items.label: [CORPORATE CONSULTANCY]:
items.text: End-to-end market entry audits, go-to-market roadmaps, and guerrilla launch activations for partner brands.

items.label: [EDITORIAL INTEL]:
items.text: MACZINE publication cataloging primary consumer ethnographies, brand autopsies, and disruptive trends.

items.label: [WAR-ROOM ITERATION]:
items.text: Fast tactical feedback loops. Concepts undergo brutal peer critiques before facing external public eyes.

items.label: [CROSS-DISCIPLINE SYNERGY]:
items.text: Copywriters pair with quantitative researchers; visual directors work directly with financial sponsors.

items.label: [POST-MORTEM CULTURE]:
items.text: Every campaign concludes with forensic metric accounting, immortalizing learnings into central archives.

tabs.title: 04. OUR PHILOSOPHY: ZERO STERILE CORPORATE BS

items.label: [COURAGE OVER COMFORT]:
items.text: Safe creative work is invisible work. We advocate for distinct, opinionated campaigns with sharp perspective.

items.label: [INTELLECTUAL RIGOR]:
items.text: Surface-level trends fade in weeks. Deep consumer psychology, human insight, and behavioral mechanics endure.

items.label: [FAMILY UNDER PRESSURE]:
items.text: The strongest networks are built under tight deadlines, collective midnight grit, and shared victories.

vision.title: THE STANDARD OF COLLEGIATE MARKETING.
vision.body: To establish an unrivaled benchmark across Asian university institutions—forging visionary leaders who command consumer psychology, technological agility, and fearless aesthetic discipline to reshape global commerce.

mission.title: DISRUPT. ANALYZE. DELIVER.
mission.body: To dismantle conventional marketing pedagogy through relentless hands-on project incubation, high-stakes tactical competitions, data-backed market research, and high-impact industry mentorship for every active club operative.

divisions.name: EVENTS & LOGISTICS
divisions.description: Architects of college-wide operations. Manages resource procurement, on-site staging, security protocols, and precision crisis handling during major multi-college festivals.

divisions.name: GROWTH & OUTREACH
divisions.description: The financial and corporate backbone. Secures high-ticket title sponsorships, executes business development pipelines, and negotiates partner agreements.

divisions.name: SOCIAL MEDIA & PR
divisions.description: Brand velocity creators. Produces viral digital campaigns, manages multi-channel engagement, and controls the unified public identity of the club.

divisions.name: TECHNICAL & RESEARCH
divisions.description: The intellectual nerve-center. Publishes MACZINE reports, drives digital web infrastructure, and delivers quantitative data intelligence for case audits.
